calculation.description: Cross-sectional reversal score: assets near the lower end of their trailing five-session price channel receive higher scores; zero channel width is missing. The signal uses only completed historical closes at each date.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC in 2020-2022 (0.04998), 2023-2024 (0.04001), and 2025-2026 (0.06702). Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.

signal_provenance.method: Spearman cross-sectional IC against next-session close-to-close return
signal_provenance.lookahead_control: factor at date t uses close data through t and forward return is t+1; online consumer must supply data only through prior completed session
